projects.name: Haus TF
projects.brief_description: Single‑family house in the UNESCO‑protected Neusiedler See landscape, set between forest and vineyard. The design balances contemporary expression with vernacular character: untreated larch and locally sourced stone reinforce regional identity, while generous openings frame vineyard views and connect interiors to the landscape.
projects.responsibilities: ["Prepared planning, tender and construction packages","Managed project documentation","Liaised with client, consultants and trade contractors","Maintained 3D working model (Rhino)"]

projects.name: ‘OPUS’ Bar — Ivan Vazov
projects.brief_description: A demountable steel “umbrella” shelters an urban terrace year-round with a light, reversible footprint in a heritage setting. Spanning 557m², it integrates lighting/sound and ties into existing utilities. A 5m² bar wraps a masonry core with storage and WCs. Polycarbonate sliders and fabric curtains open/close seasonally; deep eaves extend cover for ~400 guests.
projects.responsibilities: ["Produced planning-permission-ready drawing pack","Produced plans/sections/key details, 3D model and renders","Client and consultants liaison/coordination (structural engineer, steel frames manufacturer, geologist)"]

projects.name: Blue Porcelain Collection — Esterházy Castle
projects.brief_description: Within the Treasury of 13th-century Castle, blue porcelain rests on gold-plated plinths cantilevered from structural glass fins set in compacted sand, making objects appear to hover. Restored wall paintings and limestone flooring remain; gaps are stitched with slender brass inlay. Services conceal behind a gold-plated sculptural door, turning maintenance into a deliberate feature.
projects.responsibilities: ["Built 3D model of room and existing stone floor from point cloud and survey drawings","Produced layout plan, 2D technical drawings, renders, and client presentation packs"]

projects.name: Apple Marunouchi
projects.brief_description: In Tokyo’s Marunouchi district beside Tokyo Station. The tower’s perimeter grid forms two-storey glass vitrines framed in specially cast aluminium with 3D-radiused corners. Inside, a double-height forum linked by a sculptural white-steel stair with terrazzo treads. | © F+P
projects.responsibilities: ["Produced a 1:50 working model (laser cutter)","Produced a 1:10 facade corner mock-up (CNC)","Assisted with technical drawings (AutoCAD) and BIM model updates (MicroStation)","Involved in team meetings with structural and environmental engineers"]

projects.name: Silent Meditation Forest Cabin
projects.brief_description: A compact plan maximizing space value; a split-level roof forms a semi-sheltered terrace. Inside, a continuous built-in surface becomes desk, bed, oven and storage, softly zoning a cork-lined meditation/yoga area. A material palette of thatch, cob, cork, and timber.
projects.responsibilities: ["Non-site specific (forest setting); year-round use","Off-grid: food/water storage, dry toilet, lighting, heating","Low-impact, low-maintenance, cost-efficient build","Single-occupancy silent retreat (4–5 days) for meditation, writing, drawing, creating (max 15m² GFA)"]

projects.name: Horses for the Historic Carriage
projects.brief_description: The installation leverages controlled reflections across curved metal surfaces to create a convincing illusion of movement without mechanical parts or multimedia. The minimal composition frames the carriage, preserves clear sightlines, and heightens the visitor’s immediate, kinetic reading of the object. | © d*a

projects.name: Pathway Over the Mountain
projects.brief_description: Reuse of historic sidewalk stones, gravestones and cuboids (originally supplied by the City of Vienna to the St. Margarethen sculptor symposia) to create a walkable, climb-assisting landscape that links the parking area to the “path over the mountain.”

projects.name: Monsieur George — Boutique Hotel
projects.brief_description: Interior design and delivery support for a boutique hotel in Paris, focusing on coordinated drawing packages (GA, RCP, M&E), FF&E and finishes, with procurement-ready schedules and manufacturer liaison to take bespoke elements through to production.
projects.responsibilities: ["Assisted with technical drawings (GA, sections, details)","Compiled FF&E schedules for procurement","Produced 100+ FF&E construction drawings","Liaised with manufacturers to finalise FF&E construction details"]

projects.name: Hilton Hotel

projects.name: C Plas
projects.brief_description: Private semi-detached residential scheme in Tyrol, Austria. Powered fully by solar panels.

projects.name: Hochhaus
projects.brief_description: An urban research initiative testing a compact high-rise strategy to activate hard-to-build residual city lots, examining vertically stacked, flexible floor plates alongside rainwater collection, open greening, climatic interaction, and material reuse from the outset.
projects.responsibilities: ["Compiled research material for internal reviews on: rainwater collection, open greening, climatic interaction, and minimal footprint high-rise precedents","Tested ideas through: diagrams, sketches, plans, and physical and 3D models"]
